pairs.subject: app-shell
pairs.evidence: app/_components/Tooltip.tsx:107 The shared name-reveal used by IconAction and every icon-only control gets a pointer-events-none tip, portaled to body, and closes on the trigger's mouseleave (lines 77-79). The pointer cannot rest on the label, so the reveal fails nav-hierarchy's 'holds still while the pointer travels onto it' condition. It does appear on focus, has no expiry timer, and Escape dismisses it without moving focus.

techniques.evidence: app/_components/Tooltip.tsx:107 The tip is not hoverable: pointer-events-none plus close on the trigger's onMouseLeave (l.77-79). Focus reveal (l.81-84), Escape without moving focus (l.89-96) and no timer all conform. The earlier verdict still holds.

app/_components/Toast.tsx:12 The notification outlet is one instance (app/layout.tsx:228 <Toaster />), mounted above every route shell and portaled to body at the shell's layer (z-[var(--z-toast)]). It renders nothing until summoned, and toasts are reaped by auto-dismiss or the dismiss button.

app/_components/Badge.tsx:20 Badge is an inline content-status chip for pipeline signals, not a nav attention badge, so count/clearing rules do not apply. It does carry an icon and label, not color alone.

pairs.subject: app-shell
pairs.evidence: app/features/shell/tasks/TasksIndicator.tsx:89 The Tasks nav entry can show three full pills side by side (unread failures, unread successes, running count; lines 89-117), with no single ranked slot, no overflow marker and no '99+' cap. That breaks badge-and-attention's 'one slot, ranked' and display-cap rules. The predicates, the server-side seen_at mark and the dwell-gated clearing all conform.

techniques.evidence: app/features/shell/tasks/TasksIndicator.tsx:109 A third full pill can sit beside the failed and unread-OK pills on one entry, and counts render raw (no 99+). Conformant parts: derived predicates (UNSEEN_DONE in tasksProviderTypes.ts:89), a server-side seen_at mark, clearing only after a 1.5s dwell over the rows actually drawn (TasksRunsPanel.tsx:83), and an alert grade carrying an icon.

app/features/shell/tasks/TasksProvider.tsx:154 The poller mounts once in Workspace.tsx:242, above the keyed tab panel. Its cleanup clears the timer and focus listener (l.188-192), it backs off on failure, and a dead queue is reported (queueUnreachable), not left silent.

app/features/shell/tasks/TasksIndicator.tsx:80 The active state is a prop derived from the shell's location (WorkspaceNavDrawer passes active === "tasks"). Opening goes through the shell's selectTab door, and the indicator stores no active flag.

pairs.registryProposal: badge-and-attention's 'one slot, ranked' rule could say whether a working-state count (running tasks) and a load meter count as a separate ambient indicator or must compete for the same slot as the unread and alert badges; the current text leaves that ambiguous for activity entries.
